rows.definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
拉、推、交换、投掷其他单位（如动人之舐、移形换位）

text_741f.desc_loc: All sources of Spell Lifesteal also apply to Pure Damage. Queen of Pain gains Spell Lifesteal that increases with proximity to her enemies. Lifesteal is at its maximum when the enemy is %close_radius% units or closer to her and at its minimum when the enemy is %max_radius% units or further from her.
facets_loc: Spell Lifesteal also applies to Pure & Magical reflected damage.

rows.definition: 技能（或技能的一部分）会被破坏暂时失效；以游戏文件IsBreakable=1为准
攻击或技能恢复自身生命：按造成的伤害、按目标生命或每次攻击固定值（攻击吸血、技能吸血、如噬魂鬼·盛宴、附魂面具）
